description.value:
Frequency once per hour

You change between your Light and Shadow aspects. Your appearance, voice, and aura change completely; nothing short of true seeing connects the two.

In Shadow, your 1st Technique becomes a single-target confuse effect (Will save, confused 1 round on a failure) instead of its usual effect.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Gemini — the Other Dimension]. Remember to flip the Two Faces toggle on the Cloth feature so predicates follow you.
